stem: A bookstore has 3,000 regular customers. The owner selected 250 of these customers at random and asked whether they would join a monthly reading club. Of the customers surveyed, 40% said they would join. Based on the survey, about how many of the bookstore's 3,000 regular customers would be expected to join the reading club?
solution: The 250 customers are a random sample of the regular customers, so the sample percent can be applied to all 3,000.
verify:
customers, sampled, pct = 3000, 250, Rational(40, 100)
est = pct * customers
assert est == 1200
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [est]
